build_converter: build a Converter subclass that converts high-level ExampleInput and Example sequences to batched low-level tensor dicts
create_model: create a Model subclass implementing compute_losses_and_metrics, decode, log_prob, and converter property
test_fine_tuner: test a FineTuner subclass by calling fine_tune with training and validation Example sequences
run_inference_fn: run an InferenceFn subclass to perform inference on ExampleInput sequences and collect measurements
review_model_decode: review the Model.decode method that decodes tokens and returns them with corresponding floats
